notes: Proof on the proportion metric, full windows: before = the 21 baseline daily proportions, after = the 24 post-change daily proportions (2026-08-10 -> 09-05; the six bedding-in days are excluded on both sides of every claim). Deliberate scope call, stated: usl/lsl are left empty, so the artifact's continuous-baseline blocks honestly report their gate as not-run -- spec-limit capability indices on daily proportions are the continuous path's language, and this thread's stability read lives in the frozen p-charts (baseline-pchart.json, control-chart.json) with DPMO/sigma from T-10 as the capability language (matrix 2.4.3). What this artifact is here to compute: the threshold check AS DECLARED (0.05 daily proportion, declared 2026-08-01 in the rollout memo, before the window), the supporting Welch t on the daily proportions, the confounder echo (term-start surge declared -- it could only raise the after-rate, so it weakens without being able to manufacture the win), the guardrails, and the charter gap arithmetic (baseline 0.08621 measured, goal 0.043). after_mean here is the UNWEIGHTED mean of daily proportions (0.0368); the pooled rate is 0.0379 -- both stated, the chart and the z-test carry the pooled one.

plain_language.comparison_summary: Compared before (n=21, mean=0.08539) against after (n=24, mean=0.03682) using Welch's two-sample t-test (unequal variances assumed by default -- no equal-variance check to trip on).
plain_language.p_value_meaning: p = 0.0000, below the alpha=0.05 threshold: if there were truly no difference, a result at least this far from 'no difference' would turn up by chance alone only about 2e-05% of the time. That makes the difference statistically detectable here -- it does not mean the null hypothesis is false with that probability, and it says nothing yet about whether the difference is big enough to matter.
plain_language.effect_size_in_words: Cohen's d = 2.00 -- a large difference (Cohen 1988 conventional bands: negligible<0.2, small<0.5, medium<0.8, large>=0.8).
plain_language.practical_significance_prompt: Statistically detectable ≠ big enough to matter -- compare the effect size above against the goal.

provenance.method: Welch's two-sample t-test (scipy.stats.ttest_ind, equal_var=False; NIST/SEMATECH §7.3.1 unequal-variance form + Welch-Satterthwaite df) + Cohen's d on the unweighted-average SD (Delacre, Lakens & Leys 2017)

gap = |goal - baseline| directionally; recovered = |after - baseline| directionally; remaining = gap - recovered; goal_met = remaining <= 0 (PLAN §4.1 Improve-loop gap arithmetic, rubric R-IMP-04, BoK IV.C.1)
